title: Chapter whereby one assumeth the form of the Crocodile god Sebak

verses.t: Chapter whereby one assumeth the form of the Crocodile god [Sebak.
For I am the Crocodile god in all his terrors.
I am the Crocodile god in the form of man. I am he who carrieth off with violence. I am the almighty Fish in Kamurit.
I am the Lord to whom one bendeth down in Sechem.
